neighbours.label: The word piece 'asc' / 'ASC' / 'Asc' where the tokenizer splits it off (asc+ites, asc+ot, asc+etic, ASC+O, Asc+ension); quiet on asc- words that are single tokens (ascent, ascend, ascending, ascertain, ASCII) and on -asc- inside other words.
fire: Under the microscope the fungus showed a single ascus full of spores.
The new drug data were presented at the ASCO meeting in Chicago.
Her family goes to Royal Ascot every June to watch the races.
In the desert, early Christian ascetics lived alone in caves.
The doctors drained two liters of fluid caused by ascites.
The shop sold silk ascots, bow ties, and pocket squares.
Each tunicate, or ascidian, filters seawater through its body.
The church holds a special service on Ascension Day each spring.
quiet: Under the microscope the fungus showed a single cell full of spores.
The new drug data were presented at the cancer meeting in Chicago.
Her family watched the balloon ascend over the hills every June.
In the desert, early hikers made a slow ascent to the caves.
The doctors tried to ascertain what caused the fluid buildup.
The shop sold silk ties, bow ties, and pocket squares.
Each record was sorted in ascending order by date.
The church printed its schedule in plain ASCII text each spring.
